items.title: 6.2.1 Basic Concepts of Cloud Computing (Roman Urdu)

blocks.text: Cloud computing kuch bunyadi tasawwurat (concepts) par khari hai; inhi se woh kaam karti hai aur inhi se us ke faide milte hain. Agle hisson mein yeh teen concepts aate hain: virtualization, scalability aur elasticity, aur on-demand access.

blocks.prompt: Cloud computing ke bunyadi concepts kaun se hain?
blocks.explanation: Virtualization, scalability aur elasticity, aur on-demand access.

items: Bunyadi concepts: virtualization, scalability, elasticity, on-demand access.
